name: Jarvis Beta
changes_cs: Zrychleno ulozeni nastaveni a prepinani skinu: odstranena redundantni uplna obnova UI a ikony se cacheuji v pameti.
changes_en: Improved Settings save and skin switching responsiveness: removed redundant full UI rebuilds and cached icon assets in memory.

history.changes_cs: Zrychleno ulozeni nastaveni a prepinani skinu: odstranena redundantni uplna obnova UI a ikony se cacheuji v pameti.
history.changes_en: Improved Settings save and skin switching responsiveness: removed redundant full UI rebuilds and cached icon assets in memory.

history.changes_cs: Setup uz neblokuje bezny demand-start stav sluzby Windows Installer pred spustenim msiexec. Pri selhani uklada diagnostiku prednostne do ProgramData\\Jarvis\\setup-failures s fallbackem do LocalAppData.
history.changes_en: Setup no longer blocks the normal demand-start state of Windows Installer before launching msiexec. On failure, diagnostics are stored primarily in ProgramData\\Jarvis\\setup-failures with a LocalAppData fallback.

history.changes_cs: Pri selhani instalace nebo odinstalace Jarvis trvale archivuje uplny MSI log do AppData\\Local\\Jarvis\\setup-failures. Kdyz Windows Installer log nevytvori, archiv obsahuje fazi, kod a detail chyby.
history.changes_en: When installation or uninstallation fails, Jarvis permanently archives the full MSI log in AppData\\Local\\Jarvis\\setup-failures. If Windows Installer creates no log, the archive records the phase, error code, and failure detail.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis v0.9.15 beta: WDUi vertex a pixel HLSL shadery se predem kompiluji pres fxc.exe. Release gate pred MSI vyzaduje available=1, used_precompiled=1 a nenulovy warmup cas, takze runtime D3DCompile fallback nelze vydat. Lokalizacni pamet obsahuje doplnene UI preklady pro vsech 78 podporovanych jazyku. Beta je zamerne nepodepsana; rucni instalacni QA neni v tomto vydani zaznamenana.
history.changes_en: Jarvis v0.9.15 beta: WDUi vertex and pixel HLSL shaders are precompiled with fxc.exe. The release gate requires available=1, used_precompiled=1, and a positive warmup duration before MSI creation, so a runtime D3DCompile fallback cannot ship. Localization memory now contains UI translations for all 78 supported languages. This beta is intentionally unsigned; manual installation QA is not recorded for this release.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis beta 0.9.14 sjednocuje dosavadni beta kod do kanonickeho main, zachovava Project Intake s confidence a cilene opravou tvrzeni a pridava odolnejsi WDUi accessibility, high-contrast vykreslovani a izolaci UI testu.
history.changes_en: Jarvis beta 0.9.14 consolidates the existing beta code into canonical main, preserves Project Intake confidence and targeted claim repair, and adds more resilient WDUi accessibility, high-contrast rendering, and isolated UI testing.

history.changes_cs: Verejna beta pro UI/UX testovani: souvisly TabView pro soubory projektu, GitHub a nahled souboru, oprava prekresleni nahledu po otevreni souboru a odolnejsi Project Intake cache.
history.changes_en: Public UI/UX beta: a continuous TabView for project files, GitHub and file preview, a file-preview repaint fix after opening a file, and more resilient Project Intake caching.
